    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    You can calculate and analyze your exposure using the UK Tax Trap Calculator to see how your income, pension, and benefits are affected. 
    What is the 60% Tax Trap?
    • Income Bracket: It affects earners in the UK with an adjusted net income between £100,000 and £125,140 per year. 
    • Personal Allowance Taper: For every £2 you earn over £100,000, you lose £1 of your tax-free Personal Allowance (£12,570). 
    • Effective Rate: This withdrawal adds a 20% penalty on top of the standard 40% higher-rate tax, creating an effective marginal income tax rate of 60% (and up to 67.5% in Scotland). 
    • Childcare Cliffs: Crossing £100,000 also risks government-funded childcare support and free hours
